q: What is the total magnification with the x4 objective?
Calculate the total magnification with the x40 objective.
As the magnification goes up, what happens to the width of the view? Predict the width with the x4 objective.
The view gets smaller (from 1.6 mm to 0.4 mm). x4 is 2.5 times less than x10, so the view is about 2.5 times wider: about 4 mm.
A paramecium is 0.2 mm long. At x400 the view is 0.4 mm wide. Explain which objective you would use to find it first, and why.

Start with x4: the wide view (about 4 mm) makes it easy to find. At x400 the paramecium fills half the view, so a moving one quickly swims out of sight. Find it on low power, centre it, then turn to x40.
